005package org.wpilib.math.shape;
006
007import static org.wpilib.math.autodiff.Variable.pow;
008import static org.wpilib.math.optimization.Constraints.eq;
009import static org.wpilib.units.Units.Meters;
010
011import java.util.Objects;
012import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Pose2d;
013import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
014import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Transform2d;
015import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Translation2d;
016import org.wpilib.math.optimization.Problem;
017import org.wpilib.math.shape.proto.Ellipse2dProto;
018import org.wpilib.math.shape.struct.Ellipse2dStruct;
019import org.wpilib.units.measure.Distance;
020import org.wpilib.util.Pair;
021import org.wpilib.util.protobuf.ProtobufSerializable;
022import org.wpilib.util.struct.StructSerializable;
023
024/** Represents a 2d ellipse space containing translational, rotational, and scaling components. */
025public final class Ellipse2d implements ProtobufSerializable, StructSerializable {
026  private final Pose2d m_center;
027  private final double m_xSemiAxis;
028  private final double m_ySemiAxis;
029
030  /**
031   * Constructs an ellipse around a center point and two semi-axes, a horizontal and vertical one.
032   *
033   * @param center The center of the ellipse.
034   * @param xSemiAxis The x semi-axis.
035   * @param ySemiAxis The y semi-axis.
036   */
037  public Ellipse2d(Pose2d center, double xSemiAxis, double ySemiAxis) {
038    if (xSemiAxis <= 0 || ySemiAxis <= 0) {
039      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Ellipse2d semi-axes must be positive");
040    }
041
042    m_center = center;
043    m_xSemiAxis = xSemiAxis;
044    m_ySemiAxis = ySemiAxis;
045  }
046
047  /**
048   * Constructs an ellipse around a center point and two semi-axes, a horizontal and vertical one.
049   * The X and Y semi-axis will be converted to and tracked as meters.
050   *
051   * @param center The center of the ellipse.
052   * @param xSemiAxis The x semi-axis.
053   * @param ySemiAxis The y semi-axis.
054   */
055  public Ellipse2d(Pose2d center, Distance xSemiAxis, Distance ySemiAxis) {
056    this(center, xSemiAxis.in(Meters), ySemiAxis.in(Meters));
057  }
058
059  /**
060   * Constructs a perfectly circular ellipse with the specified radius.
061   *
062   * @param center The center of the circle.
063   * @param radius The radius of the circle.
064   */
065  public Ellipse2d(Translation2d center, double radius) {
066    this(new Pose2d(center, Rotation2d.ZERO), radius, radius);
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Constructs a perfectly circular ellipse with the specified radius. The radius will be converted
071   * to and tracked as meters.
072   *
073   * @param center The center of the circle.
074   * @param radius The radius of the circle.
075   */
076  public Ellipse2d(Translation2d center, Distance radius) {
077    this(new Pose2d(center, Rotation2d.ZERO), radius, radius);
078  }
079
080  /**
081   * Returns the center of the ellipse.
082   *
083   * @return The center of the ellipse.
084   */
085  public Pose2d getCenter() {
086    return m_center;
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Returns the rotational component of the ellipse.
091   *
092   * @return The rotational component of the ellipse.
093   */
094  public Rotation2d getRotation() {
095    return m_center.getRotation();
096  }
097
098  /**
099   * Returns the x semi-axis.
100   *
101   * @return The x semi-axis.
102   */
103  public double getXSemiAxis() {
104    return m_xSemiAxis;
105  }
106
107  /**
108   * Returns the y semi-axis.
109   *
110   * @return The y semi-axis.
111   */
112  public double getYSemiAxis() {
113    return m_ySemiAxis;
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Returns the x semi-axis in a measure.
118   *
119   * @return The x semi-axis in a measure.
120   */
121  public Distance getMeasureXSemiAxis() {
122    return Meters.of(m_xSemiAxis);
123  }
124
125  /**
126   * Returns the y semi-axis in a measure.
127   *
128   * @return The y semi-axis in a measure.
129   */
130  public Distance getMeasureYSemiAxis() {
131    return Meters.of(m_ySemiAxis);
132  }
133
134  /**
135   * Returns the focal points of the ellipse. In a perfect circle, this will always return the
136   * center.
137   *
138   * @return The focal points.
139   */
140  public Pair<Translation2d, Translation2d> getFocalPoints() {
141    // Major semi-axis
142    double a = Math.max(m_xSemiAxis, m_ySemiAxis);
143
144    // Minor semi-axis
145    double b = Math.min(m_xSemiAxis, m_ySemiAxis);
146
147    double c = Math.sqrt(a * a - b * b);
148
149    if (m_xSemiAxis > m_ySemiAxis) {
150      return new Pair<>(
151          m_center.plus(new Transform2d(-c, 0.0, Rotation2d.ZERO)).getTranslation(),
152          m_center.plus(new Transform2d(c, 0.0, Rotation2d.ZERO)).getTranslation());
153    } else {
154      return new Pair<>(
155          m_center.plus(new Transform2d(0.0, -c, Rotation2d.ZERO)).getTranslation(),
156          m_center.plus(new Transform2d(0.0, c, Rotation2d.ZERO)).getTranslation());
157    }
158  }
159
160  /**
161   * Transforms the center of the ellipse and returns the new ellipse.
162   *
163   * @param other The transform to transform by.
164   * @return The transformed ellipse.
165   */
166  public Ellipse2d transformBy(Transform2d other) {
167    return new Ellipse2d(m_center.transformBy(other), m_xSemiAxis, m_ySemiAxis);
168  }
169
170  /**
171   * Rotates the center of the ellipse and returns the new ellipse.
172   *
173   * @param other The rotation to transform by.
174   * @return The rotated ellipse.
175   */
176  public Ellipse2d rotateBy(Rotation2d other) {
177    return new Ellipse2d(m_center.rotateBy(other), m_xSemiAxis, m_ySemiAxis);
178  }
179
180  /**
181   * Checks if a point is intersected by this ellipse's circumference.
182   *
183   * @param point The point to check.
184   * @return True, if this ellipse's circumference intersects the point.
185   */
186  public boolean intersects(Translation2d point) {
187    return Math.abs(1.0 - solveEllipseEquation(point)) <= 1E-9;
188  }
189
190  /**
191   * Checks if a point is contained within this ellipse. This is inclusive, if the point lies on the
192   * circumference this will return {@code true}.
193   *
194   * @param point The point to check.
195   * @return True, if the point is within or on the ellipse.
196   */
197  public boolean contains(Translation2d point) {
198    return solveEllipseEquation(point) <= 1.0;
199  }
200
201  /**
202   * Returns the distance between the perimeter of the ellipse and the point.
203   *
204   * @param point The point to check.
205   * @return The distance (0, if the point is contained by the ellipse)
206   */
207  public double getDistance(Translation2d point) {
208    return nearest(point).getDistance(point);
209  }
210
211  /**
212   * Returns the distance between the perimeter of the ellipse and the point in a measure.
213   *
214   * @param point The point to check.
215   * @return The distance (0, if the point is contained by the ellipse) in a measure.
216   */
217  public Distance getMeasureDistance(Translation2d point) {
218    return Meters.of(getDistance(point));
219  }
220
221  /**
222   * Returns the nearest point that is contained within the ellipse.
223   *
224   * @param point The point that this will find the nearest point to.
225   * @return A new point that is nearest to {@code point} and contained in the ellipse.
226   */
227  public Translation2d nearest(Translation2d point) {
228    // Check if already in ellipse
229    if (contains(point)) {
230      return point;
231    }
232
233    // Rotate the point by the inverse of the ellipse's rotation
234    var rotPoint =
235        point.rotateAround(m_center.getTranslation(), m_center.getRotation().unaryMinus());
236
237    // Find nearest point
238    try (var problem = new Problem()) {
239      // Point on ellipse
240      var x = problem.decisionVariable();
241      x.setValue(rotPoint.getX());
242      var y = problem.decisionVariable();
243      y.setValue(rotPoint.getY());
244
245      problem.minimize(pow(x.minus(rotPoint.getX()), 2).plus(pow(y.minus(rotPoint.getY()), 2)));
246
247      // (x − x_c)²/a² + (y − y_c)²/b² = 1
248      // b²(x − x_c)² + a²(y − y_c)² = a²b²
249      double a2 = m_xSemiAxis * m_xSemiAxis;
250      double b2 = m_ySemiAxis * m_ySemiAxis;
251      problem.subjectTo(
252          eq(
253              pow(x.minus(m_center.getX()), 2)
254                  .times(b2)
255                  .plus(pow(y.minus(m_center.getY()), 2).times(a2)),
256              a2 * b2));
257
258      problem.solve();
259
260      rotPoint = new Translation2d(x.value(), y.value());
261    }
262
263    // Undo rotation
264    return rotPoint.rotateAround(m_center.getTranslation(), m_center.getRotation());
265  }
266
267  @Override
268  public String toString() {
269    return String.format(
270        "Ellipse2d(center: %s, x: %.2f, y:%.2f)", m_center, m_xSemiAxis, m_ySemiAxis);
271  }
272
273  /**
274   * Checks equality between this Ellipse2d and another object.
275   *
276   * @param obj The other object.
277   * @return Whether the two objects are equal or not.
278   */
279  @Override
280  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
281    if (obj instanceof Ellipse2d) {
282      return ((Ellipse2d) obj).getCenter().equals(m_center)
283          && ((Ellipse2d) obj).getXSemiAxis() == m_xSemiAxis
284          && ((Ellipse2d) obj).getYSemiAxis() == m_ySemiAxis;
285    }
286    return false;
287  }
288
289  @Override
290  public int hashCode() {
291    return Objects.hash(m_center, m_xSemiAxis, m_ySemiAxis);
292  }
293
294  /**
295   * Solves the equation of an ellipse from the given point. This is a helper function used to
296   * determine if that point lies inside of or on an ellipse.
297   *
298   * <pre>
299   * (x - h)²/a² + (y - k)²/b² = 1
300   * </pre>
301   *
302   * @param point The point to solve for.
303   * @return < 1.0 if the point lies inside the ellipse, == 1.0 if a point lies on the ellipse, and
304   *     > 1.0 if the point lies outsides the ellipse.
305   */
306  private double solveEllipseEquation(Translation2d point) {
307    // Rotate the point by the inverse of the ellipse's rotation
308    point = point.rotateAround(m_center.getTranslation(), m_center.getRotation().unaryMinus());
309
310    double x = point.getX() - m_center.getX();
311    double y = point.getY() - m_center.getY();
312
313    return (x * x) / (m_xSemiAxis * m_xSemiAxis) + (y * y) / (m_ySemiAxis * m_ySemiAxis);
314  }
315
316  /** Ellipse2d protobuf for serialization. */
317  public static final Ellipse2dProto proto = new Ellipse2dProto();
318
319  /** Ellipse2d struct for serialization. */
320  public static final Ellipse2dStruct struct = new Ellipse2dStruct();
321}
